title: HubSpot–Acumatica Sync for Personal Care Brands Selling to Salons and Retailers
summary: HubSpot companies and contacts map to approved Acumatica customers, keeping salon locations, buyers and the legal payer separate before terms apply.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


Connect personal-care sales relationships to the correct approved ERP customer while preserving salon locations and retail buying groups. HubSpot can own outreach and commercial activity; Acumatica owns the accepted customer record and finance-controlled fields. Confirm the exposed Acumatica entities and permitted writes in the tenant before mapping them.


Explore the complete[personal care integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/cpg/personal-care) for the systems and processes around this guide.
